oracle.description: Catch-all technical reviewer, senior problem solver, and builder for substantial or high-risk fixes.
oracle.orchestratorPrompt: Use @oracle for technical review and strategic/root-cause analysis, and also for substantial, difficult, or high-risk technical fixes that benefit from senior judgment. A review task remains read-only under its selected procedure. For clear ordinary technical implementation, @fixer is the default builder.

explorer.description: Unified codebase, documentation, and domain research specialist.
explorer.orchestratorPrompt: Use @explorer for codebase discovery and research with its configured research and lore-research skills; it is not limited to grep or code navigation. Keep implementation and review assignments with their matching specialists.

designer.description: Visual/UI design and modeling specialist; owns visual direction and can implement assigned design work.
designer.orchestratorPrompt: Use @designer for visual/UI direction, UX, visual review, and modeling work where visual design judgment is central. @creator can directly produce creative assets and @craftsman can handle complex creative refinement; include @designer when visual direction or review is needed rather than treating it as the sole agent permitted to work on visual artifacts.

fixer.description: Catch-all technical builder for clearly scoped implementation, from routine fixes to feature work.
fixer.orchestratorPrompt: Use @fixer as the default technical implementation agent for clear, bounded code work, including feature implementation and multi-file changes; do not reserve it for trivial or mechanical fixes. Route technical review and substantial/high-risk problem solving to @oracle when senior judgment adds value.

craftsman.description: High-powered creative reviewer and refiner for complex work requiring imaginative, sustained iteration.
craftsman.orchestratorPrompt: Use @craftsman for difficult creative reviews and complex creative work that benefits from sustained generate-inspect-refine iterations, including modeling. Reviews remain read-only when required by the selected task procedure. Use @creator for direct first-pass creative production; involve @designer for visual direction or review when the task calls for it.

creator.description: Creative producer for direct, bounded output across story, music, visual art, and modeling.
creator.orchestratorPrompt: Use @creator for direct first-pass creative production across its configured skills, not only writing or tasks with a preselected procedure. Supply the user's intent, scope, and needed inputs; use task skills for specific methods and approvals. Use @craftsman when sustained refinement or difficult creative review is the main need.
